other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala.
Must have secured at least 60% marks in post‑graduation.
Must hold a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering.
Applicant must not be a permanent employee at the time of application.
Age limit is 40 years (relaxed by 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST candidates).
Must not have previously availed any Post‑Doctoral Fellowship from KSCSTE or elsewhere.
Must have published at least one research paper in an SCI journal or secured a patent.

Research centre must be different from the Ph.D. research centre and preferably located in Kerala, though premier national institutions (IISER, IIT, IISc, etc.) are also eligible; eligible centres are government, R&D institutions or university departments.
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance or stipend from any other source simultaneously and must provide an undertaking to that effect.
Applicant must not collaborate with a foreign party without prior Council approval.
benefits_summary: Post‑Doctoral Fellowship of ₹45,000 per month plus 10 % HRA and an annual contingency grant of ₹75,000 for a maximum duration of two years.
